items.title: The graduate premium can no longer be taken for granted.
items.statement: A degree is no longer a guaranteed route to economic security. Students, particularly international students making a substantial investment, need an authentic experience that expands what they can know, do and contribute, together with credible evidence of that value.

items.title: Build a purpose-led model of graduate futures.
items.statement: King's will connect disciplinary education, meaningful experience, student agency and credible evidence into one responsive institutional ecology, rather than reducing employability to standalone services, isolated opportunities or internship volume.

leadership.title: A different organising model for graduate futures.
leadership.intro: Most universities organise the wider student journey around the course and position careers, skills, experiences and recognition around its edges. King's will retain the course as the academic spine while reorganising the surrounding environment around each student's evolving sense of purpose.

items.title: Purpose-led journey
items.statement: Organise the wider student experience around what each student is seeking to understand, become and contribute. Purpose remains evolving and student-owned, with uncertainty treated as a legitimate starting point.

items.title: Re-engineered graduate-futures ecology
items.statement: Redesign how curriculum, experiential learning, wider opportunities, support, recognition and evidence work together around the student, rather than improving disconnected offers one by one.

items.title: Living bridge to a changing world
items.statement: Connect disciplinary education and student development with changing skills, occupations and societal needs without reducing education to narrow vocational preparation.

items.title: Evidence that changes the system
items.statement: Help students build credible accounts of what they can contribute while using responsibly aggregated evidence to improve courses, opportunities and institutional investment.

leadership.claim: The individual components may exist elsewhere. King's intends to integrate them around student purpose, at an institutional depth and scale capable of redefining how a university creates and sustains graduate value.

mechanismIntro.title: Four mechanisms turn the ambition into change.
mechanismIntro.summary: Purpose provides the organising logic. These linked mechanisms strengthen the underlying experience, connect its value, support meaningful choices and make development credible and useful for continuous improvement.

items.statement: A journey shaped around evolving purpose, with clearer choices and credible evidence of what they know, can do and contribute.
Shared intelligence and infrastructure that help strengthen and articulate distinctive disciplinary provision.
A connected view of where graduate value is being created, where it is uneven and where the institution should act or invest.

proofPoints.title: What progress will look like
proofPoints.intro: The model becomes tangible through a small number of visible changes in practice, capability and evidence.
items: Purpose becomes a continuing conversation through the student journey, helping every student explore and revisit what matters to them.
Course teams use connected graduate-futures intelligence to make credible claims, identify strengths and agree proportionate enhancements.
A shared skills and opportunity architecture connects curriculum, experiences, student evidence and possible futures.
Students build a living account of learning and contribution that develops throughout their time at King's.

deliveryPrinciple.title: Built progressively, reused institutionally
deliveryPrinciple.summary: The ecology will be re-engineered through sequenced, reusable capabilities rather than a single launch or an immediate universal service promise.
deliveryPrinciple.detail: Early deliverables test the mechanisms while building shared evidence, data, digital, opportunity and recognition capabilities. These should be developed once where possible, reused across courses and services, and scaled only when benefits, ownership and recurrent operating costs are explicit.
